title.narrative: Improving Delivery of Assistance and Solutions to IDPs in Benue State (IDEAS Project)

description.narrative: The continuous attack by armed herders on some communities has led to an increased demand for food by the IDP in camps and even those in the hosting communities. While productive age of affected populations (18-45 years) are either killed in armed attacks or flee to distant locations, children, women, the aged and other vulnerable population groups are left to provide care for other vulnerable populations. The sustained violence has made it impossible for displaced populations to engage in livelihood activities thus lowering household per capita income below survival thresholds. The increased dependency-to-diminished-per-capita-income has heightened the vulnerabilities of IDP who are compelled to adopt maladaptive coping behaviour (such as begging, prostitution, child labour and trafficking, drug merchanting etc) that further increase their protection risks (such as coming regularly at conflict with the laws and quid pro quo exploitations). This project will support the selected most vulnerable IDPs with food and CRI to help reduce the cases of acute hunger and malnutrition especially among the most vulnerable IDP who are often at a disadvantage position on the one hand, and to improve the protection environment for households. In the long term, there will be need to support the IDPs to rebuild their lives through livelihood assistance to transition them towards self-reliance.
